about_the_game:
Maze of Perdition

In Maze of Perdition, you take on the role of a former Brazilian special forces soldier who, during a luxury cruise escort mission, is drawn into the mysterious forces of the Bermuda Triangle. Upon waking, you find yourself on a cursed island, shaped like a labyrinth and ruled by demonic beings who use humans as pawns in a bloody game. Your only option: fight, survive, and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

Main Highlights

🗡️ The Coliseum of Death – The Battlefield of Survival

A battlefield where only the strongest survive. The protagonist is forced to fight hordes of demonic creatures to obtain essential resources such as food, water, ammunition, and equipment.

  • ⚔️ Between each round, there is a short rest period to prepare, search for weapons, and plan the next fight.

  • 👁️ Failing to appear in the coliseum within the time limit will result in relentless pursuit by a shadowy creature.

⏳ The Labyrinth and the Countdown of Fate

The player must navigate treacherous paths before time runs out.

  • ⏱️ If time runs out and the player is not within the safe zone, a spectral entity will appear to hunt them down mercilessly.

  • 🏃‍♂️ Strategy and speed are essential to finding keys, scrolls, and escaping hidden dangers.

🌲 The Dark Forest – A Path of Terror

A dense forest where trees move and constantly change the path.

  • 👹 Monstrous creatures emerge from the vegetation and attack without warning.

  • ❌ Every step can be fatal, and getting lost here could mean never escaping.

🕳️ The Dark Caves – The Realm of Shadows

An underground maze of dark, claustrophobic tunnels.

  • ⚠️ Filled with deadly traps and creatures lurking in the darkness.

  • 🔦 Minimal light, narrow corridors, and distant echoes of screams create an atmosphere of constant fear and tension.

⚔️ Brutal and Diverse Combat – A Survival Arsenal

The game offers a wide variety of weapons to face the island's threats:

  • 🔫 Firearms: pistols, assault rifles, shotguns, and machine guns.

  • ⚡ Special weapons: experimental energy weapons and unique explosives.

  • 💣 Diverse grenades: incendiary, shock, poison, and explosive.

  • 🌀 Supernatural power: mystical abilities acquired throughout the game that strengthen the protagonist.

  • 🗡️ Melee weapons: knives, swords, and other bladed weapons for close combat.

🔮 Mystical Keys and Lost Secrets

Mystical keys are hidden across the island, granting access to secret portals.

  • 📜 Ancient scrolls reveal forbidden knowledge and grant special abilities.

  • 🏺 As the game progresses, the story unfolds, and mysteries begin to make sense, revealing the true purpose of the island and its hidden horrors.

🔥 The Final Battle for Freedom

  • ⚡ Face the island’s villains in epic battles.

  • ☠️ Survive the labyrinth filled with traps, mutant creatures, and deadly challenges.

  • 🏆 Uncover the truth about the beings that rule this place and their connection to ancient legends.
